metaTitle: Custom Ping Pong Stadium Cups | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom ping pong stadium cups for your next tournament or event. Bulk pricing from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom ping pong stadium cups are a staple for table tennis tournaments, college events, and backyard leagues. These sturdy, reusable cups hold drinks while doubling as game pieces for beer pong or flip cup. Choose from 16 oz or 20 oz sizes, and add your logo with screen printing or full-color wraps. Perfect for brand visibility at parties, fundraisers, or corporate team-building events.
